style: Mid-century modern style from the 1950s and 60s: warm teak and walnut wood, tapered legs, a herringbone oak floor, warm off-white walls with one wall in muted sage green, a white ceiling, large windows, accents in mustard yellow, burnt orange and teal, sculptural brass and globe lamps, a few green plants. Warm afternoon daylight. Photorealistic real-estate interior photograph, eye-level wide-angle shot from a corner of the room, showing the floor, two walls and the ceiling. Uncluttered: every piece of furniture stands on its own with clear space around it, nothing overlapping. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
sameHouse: The reference photo shows another room of the same house. Keep exactly the same floor, wall colours and finishes, ceiling, window style, light, colour palette and furniture style, and the same camera height and lens.
